resources.string: Draw near an edge and the line follows it. Drag the body to move it, rotate with two fingers.
Wherever you draw, the line follows the circle. Drag the pin to move it, use the handle to change the radius.
Tap a shape on the canvas or pick one from the library
Draw near the template\'s edges; move and resize it with the handles.
Opens a ruler: lines drawn near its edge follow the edge. Change type, unit and scale with the buttons beside the ruler.
Opens a shape template: tap a shape or pick one from the library; lines drawn near its edges follow them.
